global_guards: Every relation is evidence-only and non-authorizing.
No relation may decide theology, canon, authorship, dependence, identity, fulfillment, present legal force, land entitlement, ethics, or modern geopolitical mapping.
Roots, lemmas, versions, headings, paragraph markers, cross-references, and chapter numbers are evidence only.
Prefer the larger coherent unit when hydration cannot preserve command-performance-interpretation, accusation-sentence-response, vision-tour, lament, legal register, or allotment function.
Identity, fulfillment, violence, divine agency, temple, law, land, and pastoral-safety disputes remain answerable human/external-AI holds.
No consensus is forced; reasoned appeals remain append-only.
